This is the official website that belongs to Sun Flower Company Limited. HanoiHotelGroup.com has been listed our chains of hotels in the Heart of Hanoi Old Quarter, Hanoi City, Vietnam! WHO ARE WE The boutique Hospitality in the Heart of Hanoi, with a group of 14 boutique hotels, each with its own soul, its own story, and its own brand identity, all are operated by a professional hospitality group with over 23 years of experience, dating back to 2002. At the heart of our company is CEO Moon Pham (Mrs. Moon), a passionate woman who has built not only a brand but a culture of heartfelt service. With an experienced, dedicated, and united team, we are proud to bring warm, friendly, and authentic Hanoi experiences to thousands of international visitors every year. WHERE ARE WE LOCATED? All our hotels are perfectly located in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, the city's vibrant cultural and historical core. Just steps away from Hoan Kiem Lake, the weekend walking streets, traditional markets, art galleries, and hidden alleyways bursting with charm, our locations let you experience the real Hanoi, effortlessly. Whether you’re here for discovery, romance, or a quiet escape, you’ll be right where you need to be in the heart of it all. WHAT MAKES US SPECIAL? Our portfolio includes a range of distinctive hotels such as Lucien Hanoi Lakeside with panoramic lake views, Solare de Monte, known for its classical elegance, or the cozy and stylish Sun Flower Hotel Series. For lovers of art and architecture, La Belle Maison and Dalvostro Valentino Hotel & Spa offer refined aesthetics and local inspiration. Each property is thoughtfully designed, blending local charm with modern comfort to create spaces that feel both unique and familiar. WHY CHOOSE US? With over 95% of our guests being international travelers, we understand your needs and expectations. More than just a place to stay, our hotels are also places where you can experience local culture, dedicated hospitality and professional personalized service. Let your journey begin with us. Book your stay today and discover Hanoi from a place where comfort meets character, and hospitality comes from the heart. Follow us on social media for exclusive offers, hidden gems, and hotel highlights across our collection.
